description: R2 ranks the leaderboard by revenue_mo_usd (behavioral-spec.md:29) but R4 (behavioral-spec.md:36-41) only enriches net_worth_usd from chain. revenue_mo_usd is self-reported by the agent heartbeat (telemetry-schema.js:12 accepts any number). Design 4.3 (design...:64-66) mandates revenue come from the on-chain realized-earn ledger and 'never the ranked figure' for self-report. The no-fake guarantee is applied to a non-ranked field; the field that decides who wins is fakeable.

evidence.snippet: R2 ... sorted by revenue_mo_usd descending ... R4 ... set each row's net_worth_usd to the on-chain ... balance
